content: The medication inhibits HIV reverse transcriptase by causing termination of the viral DNA chain. It is a cytosine analog. Efavirenz, classified as a non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor (NNRTI), works against HIV-1 by binding to reverse transcriptase and subsequently blocking both RNA-dependent and DNA-dependent DNA polymerase activities, which are essential for HIV-1 replication. Unlike some other antiviral agents, it does not require intracellular phosphorylation to exert its antiviral effects. This medication is intended for oral use only and should be taken on an empty stomach, preferably at bedtime. Administering the dose at bedtime may help improve the tolerability of neurological symptoms. Tablets should be stored at a temperature below 30°C (86°F).
